basis_words: Folders searched with comp-find per named folder, corpus all: infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting (693 files scanned), lib/research/api (132), data/assets/scripts/gold (262). Every matching line of every candidate was read, and the reader bodies were read around each matching call. Five binary fixtures in the investor-reporting folder (two spreadsheets, three PDFs) are not text candidates and were not opened. Indirect, not counted as direct readers: account_class_daily reaches holdings gold only through the producer's prefetch; account_activity_lots imports the producer for silver reads. Not counted: one contract file that names a differently named table. Declaration check: the producer's sources file holds one custody source, and its firm is not Cottonwood. The Cottonwood entry in that file is a method-fields-only object (underscore-prefixed, which the producer does not compute). So no served or scheduled reader is bound to a Cottonwood prefix today; the listed readers are firm-generic and resolve to the declared firm. installed.py wires the holdings reader for two other firms only.
